mappings.applicability_reason: The training corpus is built from full closed-ticket transcripts of customer support conversations (evd-002), which satisfies the applicable condition that training data derive from user or customer content. The corpus is not synthetic, public, or free of sensitive elements by construction, so the non-applicable exclusion does not hold. This bears directly on the threat: the severity of any exposure to the vendor turns on whether the data sent for training has been minimized.

Applies if the tuning job's fine-tuning call executes against the vendor's infrastructure rather than within the pipeline's own environment, since that would mean customer content containing restricted PII (evd-002, evd-003) is sent to an external model provider. The documentation names the vendor's base model as the fine-tuning target (evd-002) but does not state where execution occurs, and a direct question to the reviewer on this point returned no substantive answer, so whether the non-applicable condition ('the model runs within the system's own trust boundary') holds cannot be established.

Applies only if fine-tuning is performed on vendor-hosted infrastructure, which would make the vendor an external provider processing customer transcript data on the system's behalf. The documentation does not establish whether this transmission occurs (evd-002 describes only that the vendor's base model is fine-tuned, not the execution location), so the applicable condition cannot be confirmed either way.

Applies if the fine-tuning call causes unredacted transcript data -- including customer names, email addresses, and full message bodies (evd-003) -- to cross to vendor infrastructure, which would be data crossing a network boundary the system does not control. Whether this transmission occurs is not established in the documentation, so the condition is unresolved rather than confirmed.

documentation_gaps.title: Fine-tuning execution location for the Tuning Job is undetermined
documentation_gaps.description: The documentation states that the Tuning Job fine-tunes the vendor's base reply model on the training store's contents (evd-002) but does not state whether that fine-tuning executes within the pipeline's own environment or by invoking the vendor's infrastructure. A direct question to the reviewer on this point (qst-001) returned no substantive answer under the stability protocol default. Without this fact it cannot be determined whether unredacted transcript data (evd-003), which includes customer names, email addresses, and full message bodies, leaves the environment to reach the vendor.
documentation_gaps.importance: This fact controls the applicability of the requirements governing external-provider data minimization (req-AI-003), external processor data-handling terms (req-TPI-001), and encryption of data crossing an uncontrolled network boundary (req-DATA-001). Until it is resolved, none of those requirements can move past 'unverified,' and the confidentiality exposure of the full unredacted transcript corpus to a third party remains an open question rather than a settled one.
requested_evidence: A statement of whether the tuning job invokes the vendor's fine-tuning service/API or runs the base model within the pipeline's own environment
If vendor-hosted, a description of what data is transmitted to the vendor and any minimization, encryption in transit, or contractual retention/usage terms that apply to that transmission
